payloads.name: Analysis (NCA)
payloads.summary: Queue an NCA analysis (nca_workflow) with a calculation config; entry point is fileId

payloads.name: Data Cleaning
payloads.summary: Queue a data-cleaning run (data_cleaning_workflow); entry point is fileId. Rules apply in order and can be composite (a grouping rule nests its own rules[]).

payloads.name: Custom Calculations
payloads.summary: Queue custom post-analysis calculations; chains off a prior run via parentExecutionId

payloads.name: Custom Plots & Tables
payloads.summary: Queue custom plots and/or tables; chains off a prior run via parentExecutionId. customPlots and customTables can each be sent on their own, or together in one body to run simultaneously (shown here).
